name: IC Interface USB — USB — QSOP
description: Surface-mount USB interface IC cluster in QSOP packaging, featuring parts such as CH334R and CH334U with 16-pin and 28-pin 0.635mm pitch footprints.
selection_hints: Select based on required pin count: 16-pin (QSOP-16) or 28-pin (QSOP-28).
Prefer Tier A representative part CH334R over Tier B CH334U when higher quality tier is required.
Verify body size requirements (3.9x4.9mm for CH334R vs 3.9x9.9mm for CH334U).
Ensure target layout uses surface-mount (SMD) QSOP packaging.
avoid_when: The PCB design requires package families other than QSOP.
Through-hole mounting is required instead of SMD.
The target circuit requires an interface standard other than USB.
